description: This Java class is a Spring Boot REST controller named PersonController that manages CRUD operations for Person entities. It handles HTTP requests for listing, adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting persons via specified endpoints and uses DTOs for data transfer.

classes.name: PersonController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller managing Person entities with endpoints for listing, adding, retrieving, updating, and deleting persons, utilizing DTOs, services, and mappers.

methods.name: getAllPersonsByPage
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of all persons, transforming entities to DTOs for response.

methods.name: addPerson
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new person, validating input DTO and returning a positive response.

methods.name: getPersonByIdByUsingPathParam
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a person's details by ID, validating input and converting entity to DTO.

methods.name: updatePerson
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing person by ID, validating inputs and returning the updated entity.

methods.name: deletePerson
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a person by ID.
